text:
tess: NeuroPulse returned a combined DPA + SOC2 questionnaire as part of renewal. Their unusual asks: separate retention for embeddings used only in caching vs. embeddings used for model improvement, confirmation of BYOK across Dedicated/Private/Hosted, and whether we can share SOC2 evidence with their auditor. Need answers by EOD to avoid churn risk.

omar-cs: i'll draft the customer-facing bullets. short answers: default retention = 90 days for all persisted embeddings. We do not use customer prompts to train public models; embeddings used for internal model improvement are only retained with explicit opt-in in contract.

leah-ops: ops add: we can support contract-level separation for Dedicated/Private where caching TTL and archival policies are set at provisioning (examples: 7/30/90 days). Deletion emits an audit event and can be triggered via API.

noah-legal: SOC2: "SOC2 Type II report available under NDA; auditor access coordinated via account team and scoped per request." Also prefer wording "BYOK supported" not "available".

omar-cs: draft one-liners for the form: "Redwood retains persisted customer embeddings for up to 90 days by default. Customers may request earlier deletion via API or account team; contractual separation of embedding usages (caching vs model-improvement) can be arranged for Dedicated/Private deployments. See https://internal.redwood/docs/privacy/embeddings-retention."

leah-ops: BYOK blurb: "BYOK supported on Dedicated and Private deployments. Hosted BYOK is available in scoped cases; contact your account team for eligibility and scoping. See https://internal.redwood/docs/onboarding/byok for steps." Ops snippet to attach: ```
1) Customer provides KMS identifier
2) CS creates provisioning ticket with usage/retention spec
3) Ops binds key to tenant and verifies
4) Deletion & rotation documented in ticket
```

noah-legal: tweak: change "available" to "supported" in hosted line and add: "Evidence sharing subject to NDA and scope."

tess: good. call to action: i'll offer a 9-month Dedicated pilot with fixed pricing to lower churn risk and propose a short enablement call. leah  can you join a 30m walkthrough tomorrow 9am PT?

leah-ops: yes.

docbot: New doc created: https://internal.redwood/docs/dpa-answers/neuropulse-2023456789 (view-only).

tess: sending the answers now. leaving follow-ups and auditor access steps in the doc. :white_check_mark:
